notes: Concept image validates identity, palette, top-down composition, and Snake readability only.

The selected revision replaces repeated sausage-like body modules and many legs with an organic elongated dachshund torso, exactly four short legs, a tapering tail, and a breed-readable long muzzle and floppy ears.
The selected revision removes all clothing, renders the pickup as an unwrapped grilled sausage, and constrains every occupied dog section to its assigned grid tile.
The selected revision favors long straight orthogonal body runs, permits only compact one-cell 90-degree elbows, and fixes the legs to one front pair and one rear pair.
Exact sprite cells, modular seams, transparency, frame order, anchors, and runtime hitboxes remain for the runtime asset production phase.
